answer: Each new identity must hold a 500 MB data shard for 22 epochs, proved by random challenges. Like a tide that exposes weak sand, a spot-check at 8% per epoch exposes fake copies; each extra identity from one cluster adds a shard, so storage cost grows linearly while the penalty spirals up 2x per failed proof. Every vertex of the storage graph is verified by anyone recomputing Merkle openings.
